testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.code.CodeProjectTests

testcase.name: a code project gets a platform-owned repository with the scaffold on a protected main, and real files in Code mode()
change - branch commit, runner builds it, preview is a sandboxed capability URL, merge fast-forwards with the user as author, publish serves it()
private code app - entry needs the site session, content is served from a per-session capability path, membership re-checked()
review before merge - required by workspace policy, no self-approval, a publisher approves()
a failed build marks the change FAILED and it cannot be merged, discard closes it and revokes the preview()
policy - source apps can be disabled, builds can be disabled, daily build quota and repo size are enforced and recorded()
safe tar refuses links and traversal in build output()
dependency request - only catalog packages, lockfile from the sandbox validated before a DEPENDENCY change is committed()
package catalog - approval resolves the closure, HIGH findings are denied by default, explicit risk acceptance is recorded()
AI for code - a model answer is data - valid files become an ai change with usage recorded, forbidden files are refused()
IDE access - per-user read-only token that can read the repository but not write, revocable()
runtime config for app-sdk is served next to the preview, without secrets()
the change policy refuses configuration, dependencies, binaries, traversal and credentials before anything is committed()
deleting a code project archives its repository, hard delete only after retention by an admin()
AI for code - the simulator makes a real change on an ai branch, unknown requests change nothing()
